name: Cultist: Dreadnought suppresses Total Madness at 100 Insanity (#4929)
contract: AscensionTaughtAbilityData.h:35 { 25, 96, 10, 680750, 567524 } confirms 680750 'Dreadnought' is the class-25 spec-96 level-10 identity spell, the counterpart of { 25, 40, 10, 92131, 520326 } for Herald of the Depths (spec 40). Both spec tooltips read 'Reaching 100 Insanity no longer causes Total Madness'. AscensionCultist.cpp Resource() only checked HasSpell(92131)/HasSpell(805120) (Herald ranks) before applying Total Madness (803061) at the 100 Insanity threshold, never HasSpell(680750), so a Dreadnought-spec Cultist still entered Total Madness exactly like an unspecced one. Companion existing regression cultist-total-madness.json (#4216) proves Madness still applies with no spec learned.
